# Artifact collection integration packet

GOAL: The optional Village prism collection uses the actual native bag and
existing durable publisher, with useful loose pieces, two exact assembly stages,
conserved disassembly, item-bound native-kit work and a carried-item scene.

OWNER/WRITER: This chat owns only the three new artifact modules and this evidence
directory. Active Paradise GM01a10dc5 owns shared integration; authorization to
message that chat is pending. This packet grants no writer transfer by itself.

AUTHORITY: Direct user request “we can upgrade engine accordingly?” follows the
Deluxe Meme RPG source review. Reversible original Village proof is selected;
literal Marvel-world/Infinity Stone powers are not selected by this proof.

BASE: Current dirty shared checkout; inspect live Paradise handoff/checkpoint and
source before integration. Module entry is `src/artifact_workshop_host.js`.

## Shared joins for the sole integrator

1. `src/feature_expansion_content.js`: import `artifactWorkshopDefinitions` from
   `artifact_workshop_content.js`; append to `families`. No artifact sources are
   created or granted. Its commands already use normal facts/items/vitals and
   its situation has existing observer attribution.
2. `src/data/expedition_items.js`: import/call
   `registerArtifactWorkshopItems({itemTemplates:item_templates,OtherItem})` once.
   This registers six native OtherItem identities and grants no inventory.
3. `src/main.js`: import `commitArtifactWorkshopCommand`; dispatch
   `command.type === 'artifact_collection'` through that planner inside the
   existing feature action host, then the one existing `persistExpansion(plan)`.
   Native context is the ordinary `featureWaveContext()`; no new native domain.
   The planner handles optional explicit enrollment, group-scoped cancellation,
   item-gated scene responses and withdrawal. Do not publish the plan twice.
4. `src/feature_expansion_wave_host.js`: import
   `artifactWorkshopPresentation`; append its `.sections` once to the existing
   `featureWavePresentation` sections. The presenter uses existing cards,
   cost/legality disclosure, work and response controls. No new panel/CSS.
5. `src/simulation_contracts.js`: in command validation admit only absent or
   `d.reservationReturns === 1` for the explicit conserved-reservation marker.
   `src/simulation.js`: the existing group-list condition that sets
   `job.reservationReturns = 1` must also admit `d.reservationReturns === 1`.
   Refunds of apparatus/constituents/pin transfers must not count as new loot.
   This reuses the already supported simulation4 frozen-job field and makes
   the collection compiler usable by any world/group without a group whitelist.
6. `src/simulation_ui.js`: exclude artifact_collection sessions from the generic
   People simulation panel's session projection; their single response owner is
   the existing feature panel. `src/adventure_notebook.js`: route that group's
   waiting encounter attention to Here/feature_expansion_panel.

The compiler can be reused by any authored world with its own keys, recipes,
function effects/fuel/source rules and carrier encounter. It imposes no universal
six-piece count, slots, damage cap, scale conversion or learned-power grant.

## Compatibility and actual source scope

No top-level schema/save namespace is introduced. The ordinary actor facts,
completions, attributed knowledge, optional simulation person/owner/situation,
existing frozen jobs and encounter records carry the new content. Old saves
remain unenrolled. Read/render/import never seed Mara or award pieces. Explicit
meeting provisions exactly one stock set in her simulation inventory; purchases
and material exchange conserve the existing native money/bag and her stock.
New apparatus functions reserve the exact unequipped owned key as paid work
input and return it once at completion; custody/equipment protection comes from
the existing executor. Existing frozen jobs keep their own recorded meanings.

DO NOT TOUCH: Private saves, source library, upstream attribution/LICENSE,
unrelated dirty work, world/era roster, prestige policy and active worker files.

GATE: Allowed syntax/import/combined registry/native item registration/link/build
and map/source match checks. New gameplay is implemented-unverified; current
unit/browser/save/failure/regression/director suites are deferred by AGENTS.md.
Record exact current build/source fingerprints and later gate backlog. Finishing
the module or transferring this packet alone is not integrated gameplay.

RETURN: Exact shared joins, current matching bundle, new modules fingerprint,
static check results, observed no pending writes and later acceptance status.
